E2410

`E2410: missing required field `{field}`` (runtime `FieldError`).

What

`E2410: missing required field `{field}`` (runtime `FieldError`).

Why

Decoding into a `#Codable`/`#Decode` type found no wire value for a required field and the field has no declaration default (`T{{expr}}`) and isn't optional (D-SERDE5, D-DEFAULT-SHAPE1=B).

Fix

Mark the field optional (`T?`), give it a declaration default (`field: T{{expr}}`), or fix the input so the key is present. Compose with `??` to supply a fallback.
